name: PIK3CA
description: PI3Kalpha heterodimer: p110alpha (full length) + p85alpha niSH2, the construct of every crystal structure of this complex (2RD0, 4OVU, 3HHM, 5XGH). Variants on p110alpha.

chains.note: p110alpha catalytic subunit, full length, 1068 aa. Byte-identical to NP_006209.2, the protein of NM_006218.4 -- the transcript ClinVar annotates PIK3CA against -- so exported positions apply to this chain with no offset. AlphaMissense uses the same canonical sequence.

p85alpha niSH2 fragment (nSH2 + iSH2). 4OVU/4OVV resolve 322-600, 5XGH 322-598. The SH3/BH/RhoGAP half of full-length p85alpha is absent from every structure of the complex and would add ~445 disordered residues.
